{{Quote|However, a Separatist saboteur attacked one of our Republic cruisers. A Mandalorian saboteur.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], describes the attack to [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>}}
In early [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Death Watch saboteur/Legends|Death Watch Mandalorian]] tried to sabotage a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], but was spotted. After a '''firefight''' between the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]], the Mandalorian was captured and later [[Death/Legends|committed suicide]] rather than submit to interrogation.
